senses.def: A small village in Cuxham with Easington parish, South Oxfordshire district, Oxfordshire, England (OS grid ref SU6695).
A civil parish (without a council) in South Oxfordshire district, Oxfordshire, England, which includes the named places.
A town, port, and rural district (Landkreis) in Lower Saxony, Germany.
A village and civil parish in Medway borough, Kent, England (OS grid ref TQ7166).
Any of the genus Chiropotes of New World monkeys with pronounced beards.
